sources.title: Bourne: Ten Simple Rules for Making Good Oral Presentations

license: MIT for original layouts and synthetic plot assets; no university logos or copyrighted template decks included

pptxVisual.reviewMethod: All eight actual-PPTX category contact sheets were inspected. The five final changed pages (5, 10, 14, 16, 18) were then inspected at full size; the other 43 page PNGs matched the previously reviewed render byte for byte. Final paper, method, experiment and results contact sheets were checked again. Main/supporting panels, the selected portrait panel, the three evidence-table layouts, and the full reference page were also inspected at full size.
findings: No clipping or overlapping scientific content was observed in the inspected render; no fonts were reported missing by the renderer.

T28 displays a readable main panel and independent supporting panel. T29 displays only the selected evidence panel from a tall multi-panel source; the original bytes and viewport records are retained.
Axes, units, treatment labels and panel titles remain inside both selected viewports; displayed captions identify the content as synthetic.
Seven short-table layouts place their explanations after the actual table and caption, avoiding detached bottom notes or a blank nominal table slot.
Native editable title/body emphasis, semantic role treatments and restrained image shadows are visible; the split label on T10 uses two complete words instead of an orphan character.
All plots are synthetic teaching data, with consistent observations across standalone and combined source figures. No research finding or verified-paper status is implied.
pptxVisual.scope: Visual review covers the bundled layout fixtures and their actual LibreOffice 0.1.5 rendering with the supplied Noto Sans CJK SC fonts. It is not user approval, a DeepSeek end-to-end evaluation, or a guarantee for all Microsoft PowerPoint/font environments. Bibliographic metadata is placeholder text and numeric values are synthetic.
